question: In a concave mirror, a ray of light directed towards the principal focus after reflection:

options.text: Becomes parallel to the principal axis
Passes through the center of curvature

solution:
The correct answer is __**Becomes parallel to the principal axis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Concave Mirror Properties:** A concave mirror is a spherical mirror that curves inward. It reflects light inward to a focal point, and its behavior depends on the position of the object relative to the mirror.
 
• **Principal Focus:** The principal focus of a concave mirror is the point where parallel rays of light converge after reflection. This focal point is located on the principal axis.
